# eventbus

Reports for the event publisher service.

## `PublishEvents`

The sink is flushed after every single line is the problem; `types.go` documents the collaborator and what each of its calls costs.

prompt: perf: `PublishEvents` (eventbus/ops.go) the sink is flushed after every single line. It writes every line to the sink, in order. Fix it; same output. CI counts the flushes.

# meters

Reports for the meter service.

## `RangeTotals`

Every query re-reads its whole range is the problem; `types.go` documents the collaborator and what each of its calls costs.

prompt: The meter export times out for big accounts. Tracing it down leads to `RangeTotals` in `meters/ops.go`: every query re-reads its whole range. Please fix that without altering the behaviour or the signature.

# staff

Reports for the staff system service.

## `StaffNames`

One call per id instead of one batched call is the problem; `types.go` documents the collaborator and what each of its calls costs.

prompt: Please make `StaffNames` (`staff/ops.go`) cheaper: one call per id instead of one batched call. It returns the names of the ids that exist, in order. The hidden checks count the calls to the store for a large input, so a small constant-factor improvement will not be enough.

# baskets

Reports for the basket service.

## `BasketValue`

The same sku is priced again and again is the problem; `types.go` documents the collaborator and what each of its calls costs.

prompt: `BasketValue` in `baskets/ops.go` talks to the pricing service far more often than it needs to, and the service that calls it in a loop has become the slowest part of our nightly run. It returns the total value of the lines. Change it so the number of calls no longer grows with the amount of data in the way it does now. Results (and their order) must stay exactly as they are.
